description: Aires d'Alimentation de Captage - Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.sandre.eaufrance.fr. The catchment feeding area (PAA) is defined on a hydrological or hydrogeological basis. It corresponds to the surfaces on which the water that seeps or flows participates in the supply of the water resource from which the abstraction is made. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Capture Food Areas - Guadeloupe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, France, périmétre, AAC, zonage, Guadeloupe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
